item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.26
item.description: Updating now shows a download bar, so it never looks stuck. Clicking to choose files (or a folder) opens one chooser only. Links come in as sound only again unless you tick With picture; dropped or chosen videos still come in as picture and sound (tick Audio only under the drop box for just the sound). New in Settings: This Mac is offline (air-gapped) - no update checks, usage counts or bug reports.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.25
item.description: Click the drop box to choose files to import. Videos now come in as picture and sound; tick Audio only to bring in just the sound (Spotify is always sound only).

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.24
item.description: Stuck folder renames now say why and can be left numbered; updating no longer hangs; Open logs brings Finder forward; new Report a bug button sends your note and the logs to Pete.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.23
item.description: Shares anonymous usage counts once a week (days used, imports, tracks, how many failed and the kind of error). Never your name, licence, Mac, links or files. Turn it off in Settings > Share anonymous usage counts.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.22
item.description: Bin names are now cut to fit Avid's 64-character limit, so long playlist or album names no longer make a bin Media Composer won't open.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.21
item.description: Copy this Mac's ID is now on the Health check's licence row and the main window's licence card, next to Add licence.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.20
item.description: Spotify links now use the team's own Spotify keys, so they stop failing on spotDL's busy shared key (your own keys in Settings still win). A rate-limit now says so, with an Add Spotify keys button. Adding a licence from the Health check works and says so there, and file choosers come to the front. A new Mac no longer gets asked to install Apple's developer tools.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.19
item.description: Send logs now sends the zip to Pete itself, attached, with a note of what happened - no email app needed. If it can't, the email opens and Finder comes to the front with the zip ready to drag on.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.18
item.description: Settings now fill the window, with tabs down the side (Health check, Avid, Imports, Licence & updates, About & logs) so you see one group at a time. Scroll bars are clearer, including the queue's.

item.title: Bad MxFer 0.3.17
item.description: Lists of links download as they're read: each link's track starts downloading as soon as it's found, while the next links are still being looked up (for lists you've chosen, like a CSV, when no size question is needed).
